subject: Invoice sender + delivery path for Atlas pilot
messages:
From: Sofia Rodriguez <sofia@atlashealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: AP Team <invoices@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Pilot PO and invoice sender question

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — the team is excited to kick off the three-month pilot. Finance asked a couple of quick questions to make sure invoicing and payment collection are set up correctly before we go live:

1) Who should appear as the invoice sender on our invoices (the payor wants to match the vendor name on their PO)? Can Redwood issue invoices directly, or do we need them to come from our reseller/marketplace listing?

2) Delivery channel: our AP prefers portal-based invoices (for automated ingestion), but they said they still want a PDF copy emailed to invoices@atlashealth.com as a backup. Is portal opt-in supported + email copy?

3) File format and PO: They asked whether you can send an XML e-invoice (UBL) or a simple PDF. I've attached the signed PO (PO_7832.pdf) and the purchase SOW. Also, do you need VAT certificates from us?

Can you confirm the preferred flow and any next steps we should complete on our side?

Best,
Sofia Rodriguez
Head of Vendor Ops
Atlas Health Systems

Attachments: PO_7832.pdf (pdf), SOW_Atlas-pilot.pdf (pdf)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Rodriguez <sofia@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, AP Team <invoices@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T10:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot PO and invoice sender question

Hi Sofia — great to hear and congrats on getting the PO signed. Quick answers and proposed next steps below.

Invoice sender: Redwood can issue invoices directly that match the vendor name on the PO. We can also coordinate a marketplace/reseller invoice if Atlas requires that specific originator for internal tax reasons. If you want Redwood to be the originator, please confirm the vendor name to appear on the invoice exactly as your AP expects.

Delivery/channel options (what we support):
- Portal (recommended): we can enable e-invoice delivery to your AP system (XML/UBL or our invoice XML) and provide automated webhook or SFTP transfer.
- Email copy (backup): yes — we can send a PDF copy to invoices@atlashealth.com for manual verification.

What we need from Atlas to proceed:
- Final preferred invoice originator name (vendor name on invoice)
- Confirmation whether you want XML (UBL) or our invoice XML (I can attach a sample)
- Billing contact name/email + remittance instructions (bank details or AP portal endpoint)
- VAT certificate copy if Atlas expects to perform reverse charge or needs proof for VAT exemption

Next steps I propose:
1) Atlas confirms originator and file format (reply-all).
2) We enable portal delivery and add invoices@atlashealth.com as an email copy.
3) Marcus will coordinate SEPA/bank fields if Atlas needs them for payment.
4) We send the first draft invoice (PDF + XML sample) for your AP to validate before month-end.

I've attached our invoice XML template for reference (invoice_template.xml). If you prefer a DocuSign SOW signature flow for billing terms, we can send that link as well.

If this sounds good, please confirm and we'll schedule the configuration with your AP contact.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: invoice_template.xml (xml)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Rodriguez <sofia@atlashealth.com>, AP Team <invoices@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T11:18:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot PO and invoice sender question

Adding a couple operational notes from payments side:

- If Atlas will pay by ACH (US) or SEPA (EU), please include the remittance identity and bank reference fields in the invoice XML. We can map PO number to both the XML and the PDF.
- For the portal webhook, our recommended field set is: PO number, remit_to_account_id, VAT number, invoice_date, gross_amount, currency, and reference. Let us know if AP needs different mapping.
- Tagging request: please add a billing_stewardship tag to the Atlas customer record in HubSpot so renewals and AP queries route to the right AE/CS.

I can take ownership of the invoice generation once we have final originator name and format.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Payments & Collection
Redwood Inference

From: AP Team <invoices@atlashealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Sofia Rodriguez <sofia@atlashealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-29T13:41:00Z
Subject: Re: Pilot PO and invoice sender question

Thanks for the quick responses. Confirming Atlas preferences here so you can proceed: 

- Invoice originator: Please issue invoices as "Redwood Inference, Inc." — that's the vendor name our AP expects on the PO.
- Delivery: Portal delivery (XML) is preferred for automated ingestion. Please set up SFTP as primary with XML (UBL preferred), and send PDF copies to invoices@atlashealth.com as a secondary channel.
- Remittance: We'll provide bank details in a separate secure form (Sofia will send the VAT cert and remittance contact).
- PO mapping: Map PO_7832 to invoice reference.

We are okay with you sending the sample XML and a draft PDF before month-end for validation. Also, please send a DocuSign link for the billing addendum if you need an explicit signature for the billing pathway.

Regards,
AP Team
Atlas Health Systems

Attachments: none
